title: Zigly Lifestyle Winter Tails Christmas Knit Dog Sweater - Frost Blue
description:
Wrap Your Furry Friend in Christmas Cheer & Cosy Winter Warmth!

Let your furry friend celebrate the magic of Christmas in style with the Zigly Lifestyle Winter Tails Christmas Knit Dog Sweater in Frost Blue. Designed to bring together festive charm, cosy warmth and everyday comfort, this adorable winter sweater is the perfect outfit for holiday celebrations, Christmas parties, family gatherings and chilly winter walks.

Featuring a classic snowflake Fair Isle pattern, this beautifully knitted sweater captures the spirit of the holiday season. The elegant Frost Blue colour adds a refreshing winter-inspired touch, while the intricate snowflake detailing gives your dog a charming, festive look that's perfect for creating picture-perfect Christmas memories.

Crafted from 100% soft acrylic yarn, the sweater provides comfortable warmth without feeling heavy or bulky. Its gentle, stretchy knitted fabric adapts to your dog's natural movements, allowing them to walk, play, sit and relax comfortably. Whether your furry companion is enjoying a winter stroll or spending a cosy evening indoors, this sweater offers the perfect balance of warmth and flexibility.

The snug turtle-neck design provides additional coverage around the neck, helping protect your dog from chilly breezes. The ribbed hem ensures a secure, comfortable fit, while the flexible pull-on construction makes dressing and removal quick and hassle-free. Its lightweight knitted design allows comfortable wear throughout festive activities without restricting movement.

Thoughtfully designed with your dog's everyday needs in mind, the sweater features a convenient easy-pee tummy cut with shorter belly coverage. This practical design allows your dog to pee comfortably without wetting or soiling the sweater, helping maintain hygiene and making potty breaks during winter walks easier and mess-free.

From Christmas morning celebrations and holiday photoshoots to family get-togethers and everyday winter adventures, the Zigly Lifestyle Winter Tails Christmas Knit Dog Sweater combines festive fashion, cosy comfort and thoughtful functionality. Dress your furry companion in holiday cheer and make every winter moment a little warmer, brighter and more memorable.

Wash Care Instructions

To keep your dog's Christmas sweater looking beautiful and feeling soft, gently hand wash it separately in cold water using a mild wool or delicate-fabric detergent. Avoid soaking the sweater for long periods, and do not use bleach. After washing, gently press out excess water without wringing or twisting the fabric, as this may affect its shape. Lay the sweater flat to dry in a shaded area, away from direct sunlight, to help preserve its knitted texture, colours and fit. Do not tumble dry or dry clean.

title: Virbac Cortavance (Hydrocortisone Aceponate) 0.584mg/ml Topical Spray for Dogs, Cats & Horses (76ml)
description:
Cortavance is a topical corticosteroid spray used to relieve itching and inflammation from skin conditions such as hotspots and atopic dermatitis, working only in the skin without the systemic side effects of oral steroids.

Composition: Each ml contains 0.584mg Hydrocortisone Aceponate, a diester-class glucocorticoid, in a propylene glycol methyl ether solvent base.

Indications: Inflammatory and pruritic (itchy) skin conditions; hotspots; atopic dermatitis; localised dermatoses, as diagnosed by the vet.

Dosage: 2 pump activations per 10cm x 10cm area of affected skin, once daily for 7 consecutive days. Do not treat more than 1/3 of the pet's total body surface.

Directions for use: Spray from about 10cm away from the skin; no massage needed; avoid the eyes when spraying near the face. No shaving required except with very long coats. Let the area dry naturally.

How does the medicine work? : Hydrocortisone aceponate penetrates the skin and is locally activated to deliver targeted anti-inflammatory action, with minimal absorption into the bloodstream - which is why it avoids the systemic side effects of oral/injectable steroids.

Possible side effects: Very rare, mild local reactions (redness or itching) at the application site. Any concurrent bacterial or parasitic skin infection should be treated separately, as directed by the vet. Do not use on open skin ulcers.

title: Vivaldis Obex (Weight Management) Pet Syrup for Dogs & Cats (150ml)
description:
Obex is a weight-management syrup that helps reduce fat absorption and supports fat metabolism, aimed at dogs and cats needing to lose or control excess body weight alongside diet and exercise.

Composition: Acai Fruit Berries (Euterpe oleracea) 5g, Inulin 0.5g, L-Ornithine-L-Aspartate 0.25g, Choline Chloride 1g, L-Arginine 0.72g, L-Carnitine 65mg, Zinc Sulphate Monohydrate 35mg, Calcium D-Pantothenate 15mg, Pyridoxine HCl 4.5mg, Folic Acid 0.5mg (per stated unit as per label).

Indications: Obesity and excess weight management in dogs and cats; supports regulation of carbohydrate and lipid metabolism as an adjunct to diet and exercise.

Dosage: 1ml per 5kg body weight, twice daily, or as prescribed by the vet.

Directions for use: Give directly or mixed into food, twice daily, using the measuring tube provided.

How does the medicine work: The blend supports carbohydrate and lipid metabolism and increases thermogenesis (fat burning), while also helping control appetite and improve digestion - contributing to gradual, healthy weight loss when combined with dietary changes.

Possible side effects: Contains no steroids or other harmful substances per the manufacturer; still, weight-loss plans should be supervised by a vet to rule out underlying medical causes of weight gain.

With its charming bear-inspired shape, irresistibly soft finish, and easy-to-grab arms and legs, Momo Bear is ready to become your dog's favourite playtime partner. Its extended arms and legs add a fun element to its appearance while offering different ways for your dog to pick it up and carry it. Whether your furry friend proudly walks around with Momo Bear or keeps it close during rest time, this lovable companion adds warmth and personality to every moment.

Regular playtime is essential for your dog's physical and emotional well-being, providing opportunities for movement, mental engagement, and positive interaction. The ZL Momo Bear Plush Toy encourages gentle interactive activities such as short-distance fetch, tossing, carrying, and supervised play. Its soft, lightweight construction makes it especially convenient for indoor activities where a gentler toy is preferred over harder or heavier alternatives. Beyond interactive play, Momo Bear doubles as a comforting cuddle companion. Dogs that enjoy snuggling with plush toys may appreciate its fuzzy texture and huggable shape during downtime. Whether your furry companion is resting in their favourite bed, lounging beside you, or winding down after a busy day, Momo Bear can become a familiar companion for quiet, cosy moments.

Designed primarily for gentle play, carrying, and cuddling, Momo Bear suits dogs with non-destructive play habits. title: ZL Nutkin Squirrel Plush Toy for Dogs
description:
Bring the charm of the woodland into your furry friend's everyday adventures with the ZL Nutkin Squirrel Plush Toy for Dogs, an adorable squirrel-inspired companion designed to make playtime more entertaining and cuddle time extra cosy! Featuring a lovable squirrel shape, soft furry texture, cute facial details, and a fluffy tail, Nutkin combines playful character styling with comforting plush softness. Whether your dog loves carrying their favourite toys around the house, enjoying gentle indoor games, or curling up with a cuddly companion, this delightful woodland buddy is ready to join every tail-wagging adventure.

Crafted from soft, furry plush, the ZL Nutkin Squirrel Plush Toy offers a comfortable texture that appeals to dogs who prefer softer playthings. Its lightweight design lets your furry friend pick it up, carry it around, and enjoy supervised tossing-and-retrieving games. The flat, easy-to-grab body makes it easy for dogs to hold in their mouths during gentle play, while the fluffy tail adds another interesting feature to explore. Its soft exterior also makes it a lovely companion for dogs that enjoy gentle mouthing and snuggling with their favourite toys. What makes Nutkin especially charming is its adorable woodland-inspired design. The cute squirrel face gives it a friendly, playful personality, while the furry body and fluffy tail create a delightful combination of textures. Unlike bulkier plush toys, Nutkin's flatter construction makes it easier to grasp and carry, making it a great option for dogs that like to move their toys from room to room. The soft fur, character-inspired details, and lightweight design add variety to your dog's collection while making everyday playtime more engaging.

Regular playtime is an important part of your dog's physical and emotional well-being, offering opportunities for movement, exploration, and positive interaction. The ZL Nutkin Squirrel Plush Toy encourages gentle activities such as short-distance fetch, tossing, carrying, and supervised indoor games. These simple interactions can help keep dogs entertained, provide an outlet for playful instincts, and strengthen the bond between pets and their parents. Its soft, lightweight design makes it especially convenient for indoor play sessions when you want a gentler alternative to harder or heavier toys. Beyond active play, Nutkin doubles as a comforting cuddle companion. Dogs that enjoy relaxing beside soft toys may appreciate its furry texture and huggable shape during quiet moments. Whether your furry companion is resting in their favourite bed, lounging beside you, or winding down after an energetic play session, this adorable squirrel can become a familiar companion for cosy downtime. Its charming woodland appearance also makes it a delightful addition to your dog's resting space and toy collection.

Designed primarily for gentle play, carrying, and cuddling, Nutkin suits dogs with non-destructive play habits. Although its soft fabric allows gentle mouthing, this plush toy isn't meant for aggressive chewing or prolonged gnawing. Its furry texture may offer sensory interest during play, but it is not a dental-cleaning toy or a replacement for regular oral hygiene practices. To keep it clean, gently wash the plush toy with mild soap and lukewarm water, following the care label instructions. Avoid harsh cleaning agents, and let it air-dry completely before returning it to your dog. Regularly inspect the fabric, stitching, fur, tail, and filling for wear, and replace the toy immediately if damaged.

With its adorable squirrel-inspired design, soft furry texture, fluffy tail, and convenient flat shape, the ZL Nutkin Squirrel Plush Toy for Dogs brings together gentle entertainment, playful bonding, and cosy companionship for everyday woodland-inspired fun.

Plush toys are ideal for gentle interactive play, carrying, and cuddling, but they aren't suitable for aggressive chewing. Always supervise your dog during playtime, especially with toys that have decorative elements or stitched accessories. Regularly inspect the toy for loose threads, torn fabric, or exposed stuffing, and replace it immediately if damaged. Choose toys that suit your dog's size and chewing habits to ensure a safer, more enjoyable play experience.

title: ZL MooMoo Plush Toy for Dogs
description:
Meet your furry friend's adorable new playtime companion—the ZL MooMoo Plush Toy for Dogs! Designed to combine cuddly comfort, gentle entertainment, and cheerful, character-inspired fun, this lovable plush toy is ready to become your dog's favourite buddy. With a cute, long-bodied character design and a playful striped scarf, MooMoo adds a delightful touch of personality to your dog's toy collection. Whether your furry companion loves carrying toys around the house, enjoying gentle indoor games, or curling up beside a soft companion during quiet moments, MooMoo makes every day a little more exciting.

Crafted from soft plush material, the ZL MooMoo Plush Toy offers a comfortable, huggable texture that appeals especially to dogs who prefer softer toys. Its lightweight design lets your furry friend pick it up, carry it around, and enjoy supervised tossing-and-retrieving games. The elongated body is easy to grab, making it convenient for dogs to hold and carry during everyday play. Its soft exterior also makes it ideal for gentle mouthing and cuddling, adding versatility to your dog's playtime. What makes MooMoo truly charming is its distinctive long-bodied design and adorable striped scarf. The playful character styling gives it a friendly look that stands out from ordinary plush toys, while the scarf adds a fun, fashionable touch. Its elongated shape provides a comfortable grip for dogs that enjoy carrying their favourite toys from room to room. Whether your furry companion proudly parades around with MooMoo or keeps it close during rest time, this adorable character brings warmth, personality, and playful excitement to everyday activities.

Regular playtime is an important part of your dog's physical and emotional well-being, offering opportunities for movement, mental engagement, and positive interaction. The ZL MooMoo Plush Toy encourages gentle interactive activities such as short-distance fetch, tossing, carrying, and supervised play. These simple games can help keep dogs entertained, provide an enjoyable outlet for playful instincts, and strengthen the bond between dogs and their pet parents. Its lightweight, soft construction makes it particularly convenient for indoor play sessions where a gentler toy is preferred over harder or heavier alternatives. Beyond interactive fun, MooMoo doubles as a delightful cuddle companion. Dogs that enjoy resting beside plush toys may appreciate its soft texture and elongated, huggable shape during downtime. Whether your furry friend is relaxing in their favourite bed, lounging beside you, or winding down after a busy day, MooMoo can become a familiar companion for quiet, cosy moments. Its playful design also makes it a charming addition to your dog's resting space.

Designed primarily for gentle play, carrying, and cuddling, MooMoo suits dogs with non-destructive play habits. Although its soft fabric allows gentle mouthing, this plush toy is not intended for aggressive chewing or prolonged gnawing. It is not a dental-cleaning toy or a substitute for regular oral hygiene practices. To keep it clean, gently wash the toy with mild soap and lukewarm water, following the care label instructions. Avoid harsh cleaning agents, and let it air-dry completely before returning it to your dog. Regularly inspect the fabric, stitching, scarf, and filling for signs of wear, and replace the toy immediately if damaged.

With its adorable long-bodied design, playful striped scarf, and irresistibly soft texture, the ZL MooMoo Plush Toy for Dogs offers gentle entertainment, playful bonding, and cosy companionship for everyday tail-wagging fun.

Zigly Tip

Plush toys are ideal for gentle interactive play, carrying, and cuddling, but they aren't suitable for aggressive chewing. Always supervise your dog during playtime, especially with toys that have decorative elements or stitched accessories. Regularly inspect the toy for loose threads, torn fabric, or exposed stuffing, and replace it immediately if damaged. Choose toys that suit your dog's size and chewing habits to ensure a safer, more enjoyable play experience.

Available in a delightful variety of shapes, including adorable animals, playful characters, bones, and novelty designs, plush toys add excitement and personality to your dog's toy collection. Some plush toys also feature built-in squeakers, crinkle materials, or other interactive elements that help keep dogs curious and engaged.

At Zigly, explore a wide selection of plush dog toys from popular pet care brands, including Zigly Lifestyle, Trixie, KONG, GiGwi, Outward Hound, Fofos, and Barkbutler. Whether your dog loves cuddling with a soft companion, carrying their favourite toy around the house, or enjoying interactive games with you, discover plush toys designed for different play preferences.

For a safe, enjoyable experience, choose toys appropriate for your dog's size, age, and chewing habits. Supervise playtime and replace toys showing signs of damage. Plush toys are generally best for gentle chewers, but they aren't indestructible.
